propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 and #124 open on GitHub but cannot merge there; they must be re-landed as Gerrit changes and PRs closed manually since GitHub is a read-only mirror.
PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python v6→v7 across 13 workflow files and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish; the pinned-action allowlist echo lines must be updated to match new SHAs.

PR #124 upgrades mcp v1.29.0→v2.0.0 (major) and ruff v0.15.22→v0.16.1; mcp v2.0 removes the FastMCP and auth API paths that rebar-mcp imports, requiring either compat validation or deferral to a follow-up migration ticket.

Click v8.2.1 is vulnerable to PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection); the pip-audit scan gates every Verified CI run, blocking all changes until click is bumped to ≥8.3.3 via a Change 0 that lands first.

The mcp constraint in .github/workflows/_optionality.yml:105 and the rationale in ADR 0050 must be kept coherent with the mcp version selected (>=1.28.1,<2 if deferring mcp v2, or >=1.28.1,<3 if mcp v2 passes tests).
Ruff v0.16.1 may introduce new formatting or lint rules requiring mechanical fixes (code reformats, import-path renames, deprecation-filter updates) that must ride in the same change.
